ai_modes.Name: Human-only acquisition
ai_modes.Rule: No general-purpose AI during first reconstruction.
ai_modes.Purpose: Protect initial encoding, mental models, fluency, and error detection.
ai_modes.Pass condition: Fail if learner cannot explain from memory at required granularity.

ai_modes.Name: AI as tutor / questioner
ai_modes.Rule: AI may ask questions, generate practice, give bounded hints, or simulate an examiner.
ai_modes.Purpose: Use AI to increase deliberate practice, not replace it.
ai_modes.Pass condition: Pass only if gains persist without AI.

ai_modes.Name: AI as copilot
ai_modes.Rule: AI may draft alternatives, code, search, simulate, translate, or critique.
ai_modes.Evidence: Human spec + alternatives + selection rationale + verification.

ai_modes.Name: AI as delegated agent
ai_modes.Rule: AI may execute multi-step work with tools under permissions.
ai_modes.Purpose: Learn orchestration, monitoring, and exception handling.
ai_modes.Evidence: Task contract + permissions + hidden evals + rollback.
ai_modes.Pass condition: Learner must predict likely failure classes before run.

ai_modes.Name: AI as adversary / red team
ai_modes.Rule: AI deliberately attacks claims, designs, incentives, security, and reasoning.
ai_modes.Evidence: Attack log + material revisions + unresolved risk register.
ai_modes.Pass condition: Pass requires changing something important when attack succeeds.

ai_modes.Name: Human defense / fallback
ai_modes.Rule: AI removed; learner defends decisions, key models, evidence, and uncertainty.
ai_modes.Purpose: Ensure the person owns the result rather than merely operating a system.
ai_modes.Evidence: Oral defense + one perturbation + one reconstruction.
ai_modes.Pass condition: Pass only if learner can distinguish what they know from what the AI supplied.
